name: Japanese lemmatizer rules
attribution: Japanese lemmatizer rule table written for qinqin by the project; CC0 1.0.
notice:
The rules that turn inflected Japanese (食べました, してしまった, 読んでる) into dictionary forms, written for qinqin and released under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

The same table is built into the server; this pack lets clients download it as a data package.
